column12: Monotreme; lays leathery uncalcified eggs; true cloaca; no teats (mammary patch); sex chromosomes bird-like; knuckle-walker; semisprawling limbs
Monotreme; can only hiss; four-headed penis with two functioning heads; foraging for insects; semisprawling limbs retained
Named as 'fully fossorial marsupial mole'; eyes degenerated and useless
'Red kangaroos boxing for dominance'; kangaroos listed under polyphyodonty (continual tooth replacement with elephants/manatees)
Named as example of gliding mammal; size/weight affects gliding
Possums listed among arboreal species using prehensile tails
Only appears in citation 110 (Dawson et al. 2014) comparing polar bear and koala fur — no substantive text
'One of the earliest-known monotremes was Teinolophos, which lived about 120 million years ago in Australia'
Shown 'with young in pouch' — but this species is endemic to New Guinea, not Australia
